entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem planeswalker, immune to Phyrexian influence, who has been buried for months and now tries to warn Dominaria about Sheoldred.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who digs Karn out of the cave-in and helps him warn the leaders.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A fire-wielding planeswalker who helps Jodah negotiate the Keldon-Benalish peace and fights the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: An ancient planeswalker and archmage who mediates the peace summit and creates a portal to escape.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrives with news that Phyrexians were on Kamigawa and that Tamiyo has been taken.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Karn's friend who sent Ajani to find him and works in her workshop on the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Stenn
entities.description: A young nobleman from New Argive, tasked by King Darien to find Phyrexian agents, who pledges New Argive's forces.

entities.name: Aron Capashen
entities.description: The leader of New Benalia's knights, whose negotiations are broken when his knights reveal themselves as Phyrexian.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: The Keldon warlord, who is part Skyshroud elf and who reforged Keld into a military force.

entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: A descendant of Sisay who now captains the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: A former captain of the Weatherlight with whom Karn served.

entities.name: Raff
entities.description: A mage who placed a tracking spell on Jhoira's letters.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: Teferi's daughter, who provides medical aid in Jamuraa.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker who has been taken by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who saw Phyrexians on Kaldheim.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor whose staging ground Karn found on Dominaria.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: Sheoldred's Tolarian aide who trapped Karn.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Karn's creator, who never let him recuperate.

entities.name: King Darien
entities.description: The ruler of New Argive who tasked Stenn with finding Phyrexian agents.

entities.name: Phyrexian thrush
entities.description: A varied thrush that is a Phyrexian spy; it attacks Karn with corrosive cables and is caged.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders now infiltrating Dominaria and compleating its people.

entities.name: Society of Mishra
entities.description: Human acolytes serving Sheoldred.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: The Keldon warriors led by Radha, who sign a peace with the Benalish.

entities.name: House Capashen
entities.description: The Benalish nobility and knights led by Aron Capashen.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: The nation of Stenn that pledges to mobilize against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A resurgent group fought by the Benalish.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: An airship captained by Shanna, which Ajani can summon with an amulet.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: A Thran artifact Karn hopes to use against New Phyrexia and hides in Jhoira's workshop.

entities.name: Mana Rig
entities.description: A city-sized metal structure on a cliff in Shiv where Jhoira works.

entities.name: Oyster Bay
entities.description: A seaport carved into white chalk cliffs where the peace summit takes place.

entities.name: New Argive's watchtower
entities.description: A watchtower with a lockdown mechanism where the group portals to escape.

entities.name: Caves of Koilos
entities.description: The caves where Karn was buried.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane threatened by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes through which planeswalkers travel.

events.summary: Ajani digs Karn out of the cave-in, explaining Jhoira had a tracking spell on her letters, and tells Karn he has been buried for months.
events.quote: She asked Raff to place a tracking spell on the letters

events.summary: Karn and Ajani return to Karn's camp, and Karn tells Ajani what he saw of Sheoldred.
events.quote: Karn set the box aside. He faced Ajani and related all he had seen.

events.summary: Ajani proposes speaking to the leaders at the Keldon-Benalish peace summit, and the two planeswalk to Oyster Bay.
events.quote: there is a peace summit between the Keldons and the Benalish.

events.summary: Karn and Ajani warn Jodah, Jaya and the summit leaders that the Phyrexians have returned, but are met with doubt.
events.quote: The Phyrexians have returned to Dominaria.

events.summary: Jodah and Jaya refuse to halt negotiations without a location for the Phyrexians but promise to help afterward.
events.quote: "We will go with you, Karn," said Jaya.

events.summary: Karn builds a scrying device and finds he cannot scry Sheoldred; Ajani gives him a copy of the amulet to summon the Weatherlight.
events.quote: They must have protections in place to prevent us from scrying them.

events.summary: Radha and Aron are about to sign the peace when Teferi arrives with news that the Phyrexians were on Kamigawa.
The news of the Phyrexian threat unsettles the summit, and the signing of the peace is left uncertain.
events.quote: Radha and Aron had not signed—and this made it seem like they wouldn't.

events.summary: Teferi tells Karn and Ajani that the Phyrexians have taken Tamiyo.
Karn secretly moves the sylex from his room to Jhoira's workshop on the Mana Rig.
events.quote: He stowed the sylex and its case on the lowest shelf behind lengths of pipe

events.summary: Stenn meets Karn on a hill, telling him King Darien tasked him with finding Phyrexian agents and that New Argive will mobilize.
Karn seizes a thrush that is a Phyrexian spy, which attacks him with corrosive cables, and the group traps it in a cage.
events.quote: Karn seized the bird. "I know what you are."

events.summary: Karn presents the caged Phyrexian bird to the negotiators; three Benalish knights burst open into Phyrexian monsters and break the table.
events.quote: Three of the Benalish knights exploded outward from their armor.

events.summary: A Phyrexian knight seizes Aron Capashen and bounds away with Ajani in pursuit.
events.quote: It rolled its body around Aron and bounded onto a neighboring balcony.

events.summary: Radha and the Keldons withdraw and lock the Phyrexians into the room with the planeswalkers, who fight them.
events.quote: The brass double doors slammed shut

events.summary: Jodah opens a portal to New Argive's watchtower; Karn, Teferi, Stenn and Jodah escape while Jaya burns the room.
events.quote: Jaya grinned in triumph as she raised her hands in a blaze of fire and set the whole room alight.

events.summary: A Phyrexian creature follows through the portal; Stenn locks down the watchtower and gives Karn the key, as they realize they cannot trust anyone.

relations.note: Karn thinks of Urza as designing him.
relations.quote: Karn had never been permitted to "recuperate" when Urza had loosed him as a war machine.

relations.note: Ajani rescues Karn and backs his warning.
relations.quote: "When has Karn ever lied?" Ajani growled.

relations.note: She worries about him and sent Ajani.
relations.quote: she grew concerned. And here I am.
to see the airship in her descendant's hands

relations.note: Radha is the Keldon warlord who reforged the nation.
relations.quote: Radha, the leader of the Keldons
Aron Capashen led New Benalia's knights

relations.note: King Darien tasked Stenn with discovering Phyrexian agents.
relations.quote: King Darien has tasked me with discovering Phyrexian agents.
Teferi's pride in his daughter radiated from him.

relations.note: Karn is determined to stop them.
relations.quote: eradicate the Phyrexian threat at its source

relations.note: Rona, Sheoldred's aide, is remembered by Karn.
relations.quote: Rona as well, he was sure.
Perched upon a cliff's edge in Shiv's brutal desert
